answer: Identities issue via a capacity-capped anchor-lease auction: the vault opens S=ceil(n/8) slots/epoch, making admission cost linear in n. Applicants bid sealed second-price for one non-transferable single-epoch lease. Each anchor stakes 10x its lease revenue; graders verify within 48h that each lessee maps to one hardware-attested vault; duplicates burn that collateral. Sybils chasing zephyr-cheap identities pay clearing fees per identity per epoch; transfers die on the marble ledger, so capital cannot split or pre-farm. The nectar thus costs full auction price each round.
